extracted.intended_audience: PR and corporate communications professionals, content marketers, and press-release writers
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for crafting press releases that attract broader audiences, drive traffic, demonstrate expertise, reflect brand personality, and highlight CSR. Focuses on structure, multimedia, headlines, CTAs, and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Showcase Multimedia in Your Release
rubrics_metrics.description: The easiest way to get attention is by including multimedia elements, whether photos, infographics, videos or audio clips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most companies have websites full of engaging images and video to appeal to online audiences — apply the same rules to press releases to get more attention. Example: SC Johnson multichannel release with 6 videos and 6 product photos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include a variety of multimedia types to match consumption preferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Including a variety of types of multimedia lets readers decide how they want to digest this story—whether they'd rather just read, watch a video, browse images, or engage directly with the news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide multiple formats (images, video, infographics, audio, embedded social sharing) so different audiences can choose how to engage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use high-quality multimedia to demonstrate credibility and commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: The quality of the multimedia included ... demonstrates to readers how committed the company is to this endeavor. It shows they care about more than just promoting their brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in professional imagery/video; strong visuals lend credibility and signal seriousness about the topic (SC Johnson example).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the press release to drive traffic to your blog (clear CTA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Syndicating your content to a wider audience — with a clear call-to-action back to your blog — can gain new followers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat press releases as part of a content marketing funnel: include obvious CTAs/links such as 'Learn More' that drive readers to in-depth blog content (Robert Half example).

rubrics_metrics.name: Write headlines that tease the main takeaway
rubrics_metrics.description: A headline that 'teases' the main takeaway helps reel in readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft a concise, intriguing headline that signals the primary finding or value, encouraging clicks and further reading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use sub-headlines to provide additional snippets
rubrics_metrics.description: Sub-headlines provide more snippets that appeal to your audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use sub-headlines to surface hooks or targeted angles for different readers, improving scan-ability and appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include infographics to increase online discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: An infographic increases this release’s online discoverability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Turn key data or findings into shareable visuals to improve SEO, social shares, and pickup by blogs and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate press releases into your broader content marketing strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporate press release distribution into your larger content marketing strategy to find new brand loyalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don’t treat releases as one-off announcements — use them to amplify owned content, attract new subscribers, and support longer-term audience-building goals (Robert Half case study).

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote thought leadership by broadcasting expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Broadcast expertise (how-tos, market research, making experts available) to be seen as a reliable source and make your organization searchable online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use releases to publicize proprietary research or expert commentary and include keywords and formats (e.g., reports/infographics) that position your organization as an authority (Deloitte 'CFO Signals' example).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use infographics to make complex findings accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: Infographics illustrate findings in an easy way that anyone can understand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distill technical or data-heavy content into clear visuals so both lay audiences and specialists can grasp the main points quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place the most surprising/relevant information high in the release
rubrics_metrics.description: The most surprising and relevant information appears high in the release, with additional context further down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an inverted-pyramid structure: lead with the key insight to capture casual readers, then provide deeper context later to satisfy experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalize your brand with an engaging, conversational tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Create an engaging, conversational news release that showcases your company's unique values and perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show personality appropriate to brand identity (playful, earnest, adventurous) to differentiate from competitors and build affinity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know your target audience and tailor messaging to them
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand your audience (e.g., Subaru's adventurous, family-oriented, dog-loving customers) and craft content that makes that audience see a version of themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align imagery, examples, tone, and benefits with the demographic and psychographic traits of your target buyers to increase conversion likelihood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use multimedia and imagery to reflect brand personality and appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Include brand elements (logo), short videos, and engaging product shots so the subset of readers most likely to buy can see themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose creative assets that reinforce brand positioning and speak directly to the desired buyer persona.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocate for corporate social responsibility (CSR) via releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure consumers know your company is environmentally and socially responsible by bringing those stories to light.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicize CSR commitments and actions to align with consumer values; timing and authenticity matter (Ben & Jerry’s example).

rubrics_metrics.name: Make CSR releases stand out with visuals, playful wording, and clear next steps
rubrics_metrics.description: Use interesting visuals, playful wording that appeals to your audience, as well as eye-catching bullet points that outline their next steps to accomplish this goal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine brand voice with concrete bullets outlining actions/commitments to make CSR news both memorable and actionable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use wire distribution to reach a wide audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Broadcast news to a wide audience via a wire distribution to ensure your content is not lost in the daily deluge of news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage wire services and multichannel distribution to maximize pickup by news outlets, blogs, influencers, and consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employ CTAs, playful headlines, and searchable keywords together
rubrics_metrics.description: No matter your story, employing new press release techniques like videos and infographics, CTAs, playful headlines and searchable keywords, can help you find new audiences and in turn, new customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine strong creative (multimedia, playful voice), tactical SEO (keywords), and distribution/CTA strategy to amplify reach and drive desired actions.
